messages:
Ana: quick check 1 PR #501 adds a short "structured output" appendix to function-calling. I left three small TODOs: a Ruby snippet, a note about nullable tool responses, and a link to the public eval guide. Can someone pick one?
Ravi: I can do the Ruby snippet. Do we prefer showing `parse_response` helper or manual JSON.unpack?
Ana: prefer the helper, but include a one-line manual fallback for older clients. Keep Ruby example tiny (4-6 lines).
Tom: I'll handle the nullable tool output paragraph + an example for an array vs single-object return (wrap-if-needed). Also recommend showing `ensure_array` shim.
Ravi: draft Ruby example I'll add:
```ruby
res = client.structured_parse(resp, schema)
if res.ok?
  items = Array(res.value['items']).compact
  # process
else
  # fallback: log and show human-friendly text
end
```
Ravi: note: using `Array()` in Ruby safely wraps single object into array. I'll add a comment linking to the ensure_array helper for other langs.
Tom: guardrails note: recommend a quick post-parse validator that checks required keys and types; if validation fails, retry once with a directive: "Return only valid JSON matching the schema." Rate-limit retries to 1. Also mention asking a simpler model as fallback.
Ana: good. Also fix: PR references an internal eval link. Replace with https://docs.redwood.ai/evals/quickstart — flagged in the PR comments.
Ravi: pushed Ruby snippet and updated links. Running docs preview locally now.
docs-bot: preview updated for PR #501 1 changed files: docs/function-calling.md, docs/structured-output-appendix.md, examples/ruby/parse_fallback.rb, examples/util/ensure_array.js
Ana: nice. Tom, can you add a one-line pytest assertion example to the appendix so readers can copy a quick check?
Tom: added `assert parsed.get('result') is None or isinstance(parsed['result'], dict)` to examples/py/test_nullable.py.
Ana: small nit: change heading "Nullable tool payloads" -> "Handling nullable tool payloads". I'll push that tiny wording tweak.
Ravi: grammar fix pushed, merging when preview finishes.
Ana: merging now; will follow up with a tiny anchor from the function-calling guide to the new appendix after merge. :thumbsup:
